headline: Driver or Multiplier? The Top 20 Bollywood Songs vs Box Office — Ranked
dek: Do hit Bollywood songs drive box office — or does the film make the song? Boxoffy ranks the 20 biggest Indian film songs of 2021–2026 on Spotify, YouTube, Apple Music and Amazon Music, maps each against box office reality, and adds the science. With Shashwat Sachdev, DSP, Anirudh, Arijit Singh and more.

headline: दंगल at Ten: The Data, The Doubters, and Why the Arithmetic Ends the Debate
dek: China: ₹1,235 Cr. 4.31 crore tickets. Maoyan-verified. Xi Jinping confirmed it to PM Modi — twice. Government extension. Day-by-day data. ATP inflation. Money laundering demolished. The full case.

headline: Dhurandhar 2 vs Pushpa 2 — India, Global, ROI. The Most Complete Comparison.
dek: D2: ₹620 Cr in 7 days, $14M NA, no Middle East. P2: ₹1,753 Cr lifetime, Christmas holidays, pan-India. Who really won? Boxoffy breaks it all down — day by day, territory by territory.

headline: Why Indian Cinema Will Never Have a Number 2
dek: The dinner table decision, the comparison trap, and the ego economy that keeps Bollywood a winner-take-all market. A structural autopsy.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: ₹623.97 Cr in 7 Days. ₹1,006 Cr Worldwide. 31 Records. Dhurandhar 2 Is Historic.
dek: D5 Monday ₹60 Cr (BOI/Pinkvilla) — the highest first weekday in Bollywood history. D6 Tuesday ₹56.55 Cr. Week 1 targeting ₹625+ Cr nett. $81M 5-day global per Deadline — second biggest Indian opening ever. $14M NA 5-day at 987 sites — all-time Bollywood North America record.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: Dhurandhar 2 in North America — $14M 5-Day Record. All-Time Bollywood NA Opening.
dek: $14M 5-day at 987 sites in North America per Exhibitor Relations and Deadline. Surpasses Pathaan ($9.5M 5-day), Jawan, and KGF Chapter 2. Slightly behind Baahubali 2 ($10.4M 3-day) in NA opening weekend. Box Office Guru: "an incredible opening for a four-hour movie playing to 3% of the population."
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: Dhurandhar vs Dhurandhar 2 — A Franchise That Doubled Itself
dek: D1 Day 1: ₹28 Cr. D2 Day 1: ₹102.55 Cr. Same director, same star, one year apart. Complete day-wise, week-wise and ATP breakdown.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: The ₹100 Crore Day 1 Club — Every Indian Film That Made It, and Why No Hindi Film Has
dek: Pushpa 2 ₹144 Cr. RRR, Baahubali 2, KGF2 — all ₹100–110 Cr. Four films. All South Indian. Zero Bollywood. Dhurandhar 2 attempts it March 19. Footfall math + ATP breakdown.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: Dhurandhar 2 Is Not Just Bigger. It Is Priced Bigger.
dek: From ₹307 to ₹414 ATP — a 34.9% jump in pricing power. What equal footfalls would mean for the gross. The ATP math, seat mix logic, and why runtime changes everything.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: Bollywood Box Office Explained — How Producers, Distributors & Exhibitors Share Your Ticket Money
dek: Who keeps your ₹300 PVR ticket? The complete guide to how Indian cinema's money chain works — from the producer's budget to PVR vs Raj Mandir revenue splits, the MG model, and why Week 1 changes everything.
author: The Boxoffy Team

headline: Dhurandhar 2 The Revenge Pre-Release Analysis — Ladies and Gentlemen, You Are STILL Not Ready
dek: ₹80–100 Cr Day 1. 5 languages. The biggest commercial bet Indian cinema has made since Pushpa 2. Boxoffy's full pre-release breakdown.
author: The Boxoffy Team
